scope: Independent focused review of SQL005 savings report reader and cash-flow.mjs integration

resolvedFindings.finding: A newer import batch could duplicate an account whose certification referenced an older record ID.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Explicit record ID takes precedence; absent that match, the unique historical business folio links the account. The old cutoff only applies to its own import record. Native dated receipts replace the corresponding imported representation.

resolvedFindings.finding: A recorded withdrawal with no identifiable account could be omitted from historical stock completeness while still appearing as cash.
resolvedFindings.resolution: The cash event remains recorded. Historical monthly balances preserve the known dated subtotal and remain partial from the unresolved withdrawal date. Current balances keep their official registered authority.

finalIndicatorAdjustment.scope: Historical completeness only, when imported history begins after the account start and no dated regularization yet supports that cut.

finalGuardAdjustment.scope: Forward and recovery outer ACL guards use IS DISTINCT FROM so an unexpected NULL ACL is rejected.

recommendedNextAction: Use the root's already authorized release procedure and focused productive verification for the exact reviewed candidate; preserve backup and recovery. This review itself performs or authorizes no deployment.
